chunks: If a man rents a house for ten dirhams, then lives in two-thirds of it and leases out one-third of it for ten dirhams, there is no harm in that. But he must not lease it out for more than what he rented it for.

key_terms.آجَرَ: leased out or sublet to another
key_terms.اسْتَأْجَرَ: rented or hired under a lease agreement
key_terms.اسْتَأْجَرَهَا: than the amount for which he originally rented it
key_terms.دَرَاهِمَ: dirhams, a monetary unit used as rental payment
key_terms.يُؤَاجِرْهَا: he leases it out or subleases it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to sublease part of a rented house for the same rent in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding subleasing rented property. It permits leasing out part of a rented house at the same rental value, while prohibiting subleasing it for more than the original rent.
